traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements in docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md are fully implemented and verified:
- Core Functionality: Implemented via detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, and generateMaintenanceReport in src/maintenance/*.ts. Tests in tests/maintenance/*.test.ts and CLI tests confirm detection of stale references and updating annotations when story files are moved/renamed. - Quality Standards: Updates operate only on @story path substrings and only write files when content actually changes; performance tests on large workspaces ensure operations are efficient and do not degrade code behavior. - Integration: Maintenance tools are exported from src/maintenance/index.ts and exposed via the traceability-maint CLI (bin in package.json). They work against the same annotation/file-validation rules used by the ESLint plugin, and are invoked in tests using realistic project structures. - User Experience: The CLI supports subcommands detect/verify/report/update, structured text and JSON output, meaningful exit codes (0/1/2), help output when no command is provided, and clear error messages for invalid options, all asserted in tests/maintenance/cli.test.ts and perf CLI tests. - Error Handling / Safety (REQ-MAINT-SAFE): Non-existent roots, missing directories, and permission errors are handled gracefully without crashing (returning empty results or EXIT_USAGE/EXIT_STALE with clear messages). Security checks prevent stat’ing unsafe or out-of-project paths. Dry-run mode for update avoids modifying files and is covered by tests. - Documentation: README’s “Maintenance CLI” section documents the tools, commands, and typical usage patterns, and links to a more detailed API/CLI reference, satisfying the documentation acceptance criterion.
The story text matches the implementation that the tests exercise, the test suite has been re-run and is fully green, and there is no evidence of regression. Therefore this story is assessed as PASSED.
